summary: Frustrated by incorrect parameter usage despite available references
detailed_context: Scott was attempting to execute Skyvern workflow calls but Poseidon used incorrect parameters, specifically a malformed schedule_url. Scott had to interrupt and correct the approach mid-process. The root frustration stems from Poseidon not consulting available reference materials (previous implementation or GitHub repo) before making API calls, forcing Scott into a debugging/correction role rather than moving forward productively. Scott is explicitly asking Poseidon to analyze parameters against known-good sources and propose corrections before acting—indicating Poseidon should verify assumptions against documentation first. This reveals Scott expects Poseidon to be self-correcting by referencing available context, not blindly attempting calls. The pattern shows Scott values careful verification over rapid iteration when external APIs are involved.
